description: A PostHog event definition: the metadata (description, tags, owner, verification, visibility and schema enforcement) PostHog keeps for an event name in a project. Requires a PostHog plan with the data management feature.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the event definition belongs to.

Name.description: Event name, e.g. signed_up or $pageview. Unique within the project. Create-only.

Owner.description: Numeric ID of the user responsible for the event.

Verified.description: Whether the event is marked as verified. Defaults to false.

Hidden.description: Whether the event is hidden from event pickers. Defaults to false.

EnforcementMode.description: Schema enforcement for this event: `allow` (accept events that don't match the schema) or `reject`. Defaults to `allow`.

PrimaryProperty.description: Name of a single property PostHog UIs show next to the event name (for example $pathname on $pageview).

PostToSlack.description: Whether to post to the project's Slack/webhook integration when the event is ingested. Defaults to false.

DefaultColumns.description: Columns shown by default when exploring this event.
